title: Three dreams within a dream: numbers, seven doors, walking on water

tellings.quote: I get halfway across and I think, "I got to do this. I can make this." And then the old woman is right next to me. And she stumbles and loses her step and I instinctively just tried to grab her arm to hold her up and we both went swept away and I woke up.

plain: In 1991, on Mount Athos, a mountain of monasteries in Greece, Ralph Larson says he had three dreams nested inside one another: one of numbers, one of seven doors, and one in which he walked on water. Halfway across the water an old woman stumbled beside him, he grabbed her arm, "we both went swept away and I woke up." Larson, presented on the show as a former CIA chief, tells Michels this as his own experience, tied to what he says was a trip back in time to Mount Athos in the 1300s.
